description: Get the result document of one scan: URLs and redirects, page title, load times, links, network requests, IP addresses, JavaScript files, TLS, fuzzy hashes, screenshot hashes, favicon and the security verdict. compact (default true) leaves out the raw network logs (HTTP transactions and their analysis, console logs, request and response lists) and the inline favicon image, most of a large result, and names what it left out in compacted; pass compact false for the full document. For a verdict alone, the scan summary is enough. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

compact.description: Leave out the raw network logs and the inline favicon image (default true); false returns the full document, which can run to several MB.
compact.title: Compact

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id
